notes: Research only: no production edits, build, broad tests, commits, push or issue updates.
Compiled controls and trusted-load prototype have three fresh sequential samples per variant/host. External load uncontrolled.
Whole-process peak RSS; startup/runtime imports excluded; full timings include parse/preparation/execution.
Phase measurements exclude helper parsing/preparation; cold isolated phases differ from warmed multi-radius verification.
The trusted-load compiler prototype intercepts generated function construction; it is not a production implementation.
Only kernels with external array destinations are transformed. Raw packed single-pass read-only paths retain their load guards. Arithmetic/store guards are retained.
All paired full compiled runs assert the 10-digit golden. Full reference defaults were not measured.
The large vector graph exceeded 75 seconds in each engine and was stopped.
The batched native heap full run was stopped after approximately 100 s, with ps reporting 1916304 KiB resident memory.
Most alternative experiments have one sample, sometimes overlapping other exploratory work; no statistical speedup claims are made for them.
CPU profiling overlapped the unsuccessful batched-heap experiment and is used only to locate hot generated code, not as a timing control.
